title: openalex_W4415951858
universal_lens: A multi-modal computer vision framework integrating YOLOv8, OpenPose, and SlowFast/I3D for automated basketball performance analysis. A unified framework for video data harmonization across multi-source basketball datasets using temporal and spatial normalization.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference of player trajectories and action sequences using probabilistic graphical models over spatiotemporal video streams. Bayesian inference over normalized video features enables probabilistic action classification and event tracking across heterogeneous datasets.
gse_mapping: Situation-aware state transitions in basketball gameplay modeled via dynamic Bayesian networks capturing player roles and strategic shifts. Situational reasoning engine maps preprocessed video states to action transitions using optical flow and pose keypoint dynamics.

primitives.name: Action Recognition via ST-GCN
primitives.verbatim_quote: (2017) Mask R-CNN (Segmentation) High accuracy but unsuitable for realtime Simonyan & Zisserman (2014), Carreira et al.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'X_{t}': 'Node feature matrix (pose coordinates) at time t (dimensionless)', 'A_{t}': 'Adaptive adjacency matrix (spatial graph edges)', 'Y': 'Final action classification (one-hot vector)', '\\Theta,W': 'Learned weight matrices (parameters)', 'f,g': 'Temporal convolutional and classification functions'}
primitives.assumptions: Local spatiotemporal stationarity, stationary Markov property, and Lipschitz continuity of the graph Laplacian.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when the graph becomes disconnected (zero eigenvalue of Laplacian) or when long-term dependencies collapse due to gradient vanishing/exploding.

layer2.mapping: The spatial-temporal graph convolution implements a message-passing kernel that mirrors the belief propagation update in GSI's probabilistic graphical models, where edges represent conditional dependencies between actions.
layer2.telemetry: Entropy of softmax output > 1.5 indicates uncertainty; use ensemble prediction to flag ambiguous plays.

primitives.name: High-Level Performance Dashboard
primitives.verbatim_quote: (2018) ST-GCN (Skeleton-based recognition) Dependent on accurate pose input Wang et al.
primitives.assumptions: Constant velocity approximation within short windows, linear superposition of individual contributions, and Gaussian smoothing of noisy measurements.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when trajectories cross (Kalman filter covariance becomes singular) or when collaborative actions involve more than two players simultaneously.

layer2.mapping: The dashboard metrics are computed via linear state-space models that are dual to the conformal prediction intervals used in GSI for quantifying uncertainty in player performance estimates.
layer2.telemetry: Sudden jump in Kalman variance > 3σ signals anomalous behavior; compare predicted vs. actual shot success rates to detect skill degradation.
